a.lede: The announcement likely comes in response to creators' concerns over how easily original content can be copied and redistributed across social media platforms, especially considering how generative AI has made it easier to manipulate existing videos.
a.title: Instagram’s new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos

b.lede: While creators have long shared Amazon affiliate links through stories, DMs, and their bios, the new integration brings them to new parts of the app.
b.title: Instagram now lets creators add Amazon affiliate links in reels and feed posts
